description: This file contains a set of shell functions for managing boot partitions, UUIDs, mounting, upgrading, and copying configuration on an iMX-based system, specifically used during system upgrade processes in an OpenWrt environment.

methods.name: rootpartuuid
methods.description: Extracts and returns the root partition UUID from the kernel command line.

methods.name: bootdev_from_uuid
methods.description: Determines the device name of the boot device based on the root partition UUID.

methods.name: bootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Finds the partition device associated with the boot partition UUID.

methods.name: rootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Finds the device of the root partition based on the UUID.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_mount_boot
methods.description: Mounts the boot partition at /boot if not already mounted.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies a backup configuration file to the boot partition.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade by extracting kernel and root filesystem images from an archive and placing them on their respective partitions.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps, such as resetting JFFS2 and unmounting overlay, if no upgrade backup is specified.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_move_config
methods.description: Moves the configuration backup from the boot partition to root if applicable.
